title: Villa Whimsey Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Villa Whimsey is a 2 BR / 3 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Reminiscent of a Victorian-style home, the whimsical ‘Villa Whimsey’ cottage offers comfort and privacy in beautiful Seaside.
description_expanded: Description119 Tupelo Street2 QUEEN BEDS, 2 TWINS WITH TRUNDLES (Twin trundles accommodate smaller children)A Whimsical Victorian Cottage in the Heart of SeasideReminiscent of a classic Victorian-style beach cottage, Villa Whimsey delivers charm, comfort, and privacy in one of the most desirable locations in Seaside, Florida. With its inviting screened wraparound porch and storybook aesthetic, this home offers a peaceful retreat just moments from the energy of town.Inviting Outdoor Living & Classic Seaside CharmThe spacious screened wraparound porch sets the tone for relaxed coastal living—ideal for al fresco dining, morning coffee, or classic Seaside people-watching. Additional private screened outdoor space on the ground level provides a quiet escape for unwinding after a beach day.Ground-Floor Bedrooms Designed for ComfortThe first level features a queen primary suite styled with tropical accents, creating a calming coastal retreat. A second queen guest bedroom offers a charming window seat and cozy atmosphere. A full bathroom and access to a private screened porch complete this level, making it ideal for guests seeking privacy and convenience.Airy Main Living Area with Vaulted CeilingsUpstairs, the main living space is filled with natural light and coastal character. Vaulted ceilings, soft pastel tones, and comfortable furnishings create an inviting environment to relax. A dedicated desk and television add functionality, while the open layout flows seamlessly into the kitchen and dining areas.Well-Equipped Kitchen & Sunlit Dining NookThe kitchen is thoughtfully designed with ample storage, an island for additional prep or casual seating, and everything needed for vacation meals. A built-in dining nook, bathed in natural light, provides a charming space for gathering. Two adjacent decks extend the living space outdoors—perfect for enjoying Gulf breezes and unforgettable sunsets.Unique Third-Floor Loft with CharacterThe third-floor sleeping loft features twin trundle beds and a full bathroom rich in personality. A claw-foot tub beneath a crescent-shaped stained-glass window adds a whimsical touch. An interior balcony overlooks the living room below, enhancing the home’s open and playful design.Unbeatable Seaside LocationLocated just two doors down from the iconic Tupelo Street Gazebo, Villa Whimsey places you within easy walking distance of Seaside’s private beach access, boutique shopping, dining, and town events. This charming cottage is perfectly positioned to experience the best of Seaside while enjoying a peaceful, private escape.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES1,439 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at Tupelo PavilionJust a 3-minute (176-yard) walk to the beachLocated two doors down from the iconic Tupelo Street GazeboPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeFull access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayStarter amenities provided for a seamless arrivalParking passes issued per Seaside regulations: 1 pass for one-bedroom cottages and 2 passes for two-bedroom and larger homesGolf carts are considered vehicles; golf carts for non-homeowners are prohibited unless a special or medical permit is approvedNo pets allowedSTR23-002234
